messages:
jae: Promo paused by deploy-bot. CI matrix failing at artifact fetch - multiple checksum mismatches after yesterday's concurrency bump.
ci-bot: [alert] 10/22 shards returned checksum_mismatch; several runners logged truncated tar reads and memory spikes.
deploy-bot: Auto-pause engaged (policy: artifact_integrity || runner_health). Holding promo until manual triage.
nina: Quick mitigation: set matrix.concurrency=16 and add fetch retry=2. Lower blast radius, rerun canary.
harry: Agree. Also want to verify object-store multipart status; ops could have in-progress parts during maintenance.
ops-ana: Checking object-store now. Seeing a cluster of partial multipart uploads during a rolling compaction window at 03:05 UTC. Kicking integrity job for the affected prefixes. ETA 30m.
jae: Release-council: can we approve emergency hotflip for canary only? If canary still fails, plan is pin to last-green and schedule reupload.
release-council: Approve hotflip for canary. Require release note entry and follow-up ticket if reupload needed.
ci-bot: Canary job 11433 started (concurrency=16) -> monitoring: https://ci.internal/builds/11433
ops-ana: Integrity scan found 3 quarantined multipart parts; reassembly pending for two bundles.
ci-bot: Canary finished: 19/20 shards OK, 1 shard failed on a quarantined bundle.
jae: Since canary mostly passed and object-store team is reassembling, manual resume allowed but pin fallback if final verification fails. I'll update promo ticket: hold->resumed_with_caveat and attach follow-up PI-4621. :white_check_mark:
